description:
Product Manager, Data, APIs & Integrations

Position Summary:

The Product Manager will direct execution of the product-level strategy and drive cross-functional alignment and priorities for all integration surfaces and ATS/HRIS integrations. The role will own the roadmap for the respective products and will serve as the central cross-functional lead with UX, development, and QA.

Expected Duties:

  • Own the relationships & agreements with and the road map for all ATS/HRIS & PMS integrations

  • Champion and own improvements to the existing integration surfaces (XML, JSON, XGW2 middleware) in support of vendor integrations, ATS/HRIS/PMS integrations, and TazWorks’ AI strategy

  • Define and own the road map for data handling and reporting across TazWorks products

  • Partner with the TazWorks InstaScreen Product team to maintain the road map for vendor integrations

  • Partner with the Marketplace team to nurture vendor relationships, including onboarding, escalations, and ongoing alignment on priorities

  • Lead continuous discovery through customer interviews, usage analytics, and collaboration with customers and partners to identify high-value problems worth solving.

  • Write crisp, well-reasoned PRDs and user stories that give engineering teams the clarity they need to build with confidence.

  • Drive agile delivery ceremonies and maintain a healthy, well-prioritized backlog aligned to team OKRs.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in a STEM or Engineering field

  • 4+ years of relevant product management experience.

  • Proven track record of owning a product area end-to-end — discovery, definition, delivery, and iteration.

  • Proven track record of shipping APIs

  • Experience managing APIs and API-integrated software products with multiple stakeholder groups.

  • Exposure to AI/ML in product contexts — you've thought carefully about where intelligent automation adds genuine value vs. hype.

  • Working knowledge of Claude Code

  • Strong command of agile methodologies and modern product discovery practices (Jobs-to-Be-Done, continuous discovery, etc.).

  • Analytical mindset — comfortable using data and product analytics tools to drive decisions and measure outcomes.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; able to simplify complexity and align diverse stakeholders.

  • Deep customer empathy — you've invested real time understanding users and translated those insights into shipped improvements.

Preferred Experience, Qualifications, and Skills:

  • Has shipped data and APIs in support of customer-facing Gen AI products in a regulated environment

  • Understanding of the pros and cons of the latest frontier lab vis-a-vis open-source AI models

  • Background-screening domain expertise

  • Built working prototypes with Claude Code
